exposure: Sex modifier used in kidney function estimating equations (sex assigned at birth vs. gender identity)
cohort: The study included transgender adults (2007-2017) prescribed at least 90 days of hormone therapy, with measured serum creatinine before and during treatment.
finding: Female-based equations may underestimate kidney function in transgender adults undergoing testosterone or estrogen treatment.
followup_time: Median 259 days (testosterone group) and 250 days (estrogen group), with observations up to 12 months post-index date.
